question: The height of a right circular cone is 24 cm. If the radius of its base is 7 cm, then what will be the curved surface area of this cone? [Use π = frac {22}{7}]
solution:
Given:

The height of a right circular cone is 24 cm. 

The radius of its base is 7 cm.

Concept used:

Curved surface area = πrl (where r = radius of the base and l = slant height)

Calculation:

So, the slant height of the cone = sqrt {7² + 24²} = 25 cm

Now, the curved surface area of the cone

⇒ π × 7 × 25

⇒ 550 cm

**∴ The curved surface area of the cone is 550 cm².**
